Reference neighborhoods and original-observation certification — 2026-10-08

PHRF-14 remains open. Exploratory fixed-shape coverage under two predeclared eight-reference banks is poor even when all eight references are compared offline. N=30 corners cover 0/64 original-amplitude targets at both 48/96 seconds; quarters cover 4/64 and 11/64. N=300 corners cover 0/32; quarters cover 0/32 and 2/32. The target remains relative amplitude L2 <=1e-3. Exact prepared-vs-original counts improve from 30/64 to 58/64 (N=30) and 16/32 to 28/32 (N=300) when support grows. Basis/representation error is recorded separately from corrected-readout error and analytic tail truncation. All eight coverage ScenarioResults are Fail. Offline best-of-eight is not a legal <=2-reference router; no decoder or independent scientific confirmation runs in this experiment.

The continuous original Cascade34 impulse observation adapter now encloses chart conversion, Erlang HRFs over all observed lags, exact-input sample/event times, AR(1) whitening, lambda=1 condition-centered penalty, normal equations and RHS. Gale validates a prepared reference inverse candidate with ||I-MG||inf<1, returning component and cancellation-aware signed-query bounds. Twelve of sixteen N=30 point attempts at radii 0/.001/.01 certify below the amplitude target; four at .1 refuse. One 96-second point has signed-query bound 3.98341e-7, versus observed 3.30865e-7, below the separate exploratory 1e-6 target. Twelve small boxes certify uniform conditioning, not uniform readout accuracy; four larger boxes refuse. Dense O(n^3) validation is charged diagnostic work outside the production single-extra-inverse allowance. This is useful original-model point certification, not production admission or a general family/drive/noise certificate.

Next: freeze a scientifically justified domain/support and candidate placement, then test fresh coverage before spending on broad adaptive qualification. Domain changes cannot be chosen solely to obtain speed. Gaussian/LWU, weak/null/misspecified and independent scientific calibration remain outstanding.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-neighborhoods-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, source base 101c5ab6; hashes verified. Gale generic outward exponential and validated reference-system bounds are in 62c0aeb3374557874a17f870c9ae05e3290c21cf (https://github.com/canardlapin/gale/pull/24, merged); ScalaFIM pins that topic revision without unrelated optimizer additions. Full fit tests pass: 707 JVM / 649 Scala.js; new observation/neighborhood laws, N=1200 integration, all 80 recovery reference cases with unchanged tolerances, and targeted comparison tests pass on both platforms. scalafimCompileAll passes without compiler warnings. Numerical/scientific/production qualification remain distinct. No ScalaFIM merge or publication.

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Residual admission and envelope-gradient follow-through — 2026-10-07

PHRF-14 remains open. Added a fixed-shape, signed heterogeneous-amplitude audit at 48/96-second supports, holding physical event onsets constant. Four shapes x two modes x two admitted horizons yield 16 records. At the same 1e-3 basis tolerance, 96-second support (maximum rank 24, selected 12) reduces largest exact/full-window QR discrepancy from 0.009963 to 0.001043; corrected discrepancy remains 0.477734. All exact readouts pass the diagnostic 1e-8 prepared-residual ceiling and all corrected readouts refuse. Four compiler-refused variants are retained; all 20 scientific ScenarioResults remain Fail due to scope/certification caveats. 192-second support still refuses the unchanged storage/training-work caps, including reduced workspace attempts.

These are exploratory fixed-shape observations, not independent adaptive qualification or a fresh confirmation cohort. Gaussian/LWU, weak/null/misspecified cases, broader global-search references and >=500-replicate coverage remain outstanding. The existing 80 recovery oracle cells are retained with their prior scientific tolerances.

Validation: full fit 706 JVM / 648 Scala.js tests pass. All 80 recovery reference cases preserve the prior energy/shape/admission tolerances on both platforms; no bitwise trajectory identity is claimed. The six targeted law suites pass on both platforms (18 JS tests; JVM runs include final two-test horizon suite). Comparison: 466 JVM passed / 10 skipped, 17 targeted Scala.js tests passed. Compiler warning-clean; existing multiple-main discovery message only. No hosted CI, merge or publication. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-readout-bounds-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, base e1d67dfb; source/artifact hashes verified. Scientific and epic qualification remain open.

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Qualification attempt — 2026-10-07 (local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007)

PHRF-14 remains open. Added four separated Cascade34 shapes with matched noiseless controls, heterogeneous signed trial amplitudes, and original-family data at noise ratios 0 and 0.5. 48 readout records retain every refusal; each mode emits 21/24. All eight matched exact controls recover shape within 3.31e-10 chart units. Heterogeneous truth errors include shrinkage effects, and the new original-family cases have no independent global-search oracle.

Each scientific record returns a ScenarioResult with blocking certificate/scope caveats: all 48 are Fail and no CI policy accepts them. The MUnit numerical audit passing is not scientific qualification. Gaussian/LWU, weak/null/misspecified cases, the weak LWU admission deficit, independent broader search references and >=500-replicate adaptive coverage remain outstanding. Seeds are consumed exploratory evidence, not confirmation.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-qualification-20261007/README.md and certification-audit.md; 41 source/artifact hashes verified.

Retained prior scope and acceptance

Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Implementation has advanced beyond the September condition-only inventory. Current local fit/law/comparison gates pass, but full truth/coverage calibration, the weak LWU target and complete B0 decision are not established.

Fresh context: Yes: scientific qualification.

Next action: Freeze current source/provider/runtime, admitted families and all attempted-cohort rules before the declared numerical, search, recovery/coverage and resource courts. Preserve >=500-replicate floors, uncertainty intervals, misspecified/null cases and consumed-seed distinctions.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; live PHRF-11/21/33 dependencies.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Roadmap refinement 2026-09-13: close only after requalified PHRF-21, integrated PHRF-11 and the complete PHRF-33 backend-decision receipt (plus existing Cascade34 dependency). A completed backend microbenchmark cannot satisfy the latter.

Freeze family domains, criterion/noise/lambda/prior/normalization, response generation, schedules, seeds, source/provider revisions and accuracy/admission criteria before confirmation. Keep four reports separate: fixed-shape numerical agreement, decoded-vs-sufficiently-searched same-model agreement, scientific truth recovery/coverage under misspecification, and resources.

Include Gaussian/LWU/Cascade34 within their explicitly admitted domains, signed/near-zero amplitudes and queries, weak/null/rho=0 cases, neural-timing confounding, unequal/singleton/coincident trials, nuisance/AR/run effects, prior strength and leakage-free pooled preparation. Compare corrected terminal-curvature admission to the historical result; carry LWU SNR 0.5 shortfall forward.

Intervals and adequacy claims require >=500 independent replicates per regime plus binomial uncertainty and preregistered acceptable coverage/error tolerances. Distinguish conditional-at-frozen-shape uncertainty, estimated-noise/AR/lambda/prior uncertainty, and full adaptive estimator coverage. Preserve inconclusive and failed cells; do not replace required tests with accepted-only summaries. Exact revisions, raw results and executable JVM/JS numerical fixtures accompany each claim. FiniteState enters this court only if explicitly activated by PHRF-33.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Scope restated without finite-state requirements. Acceptance:

- Four separated comparisons from the plan: conditional numerical agreement,
  decoder agreement against sufficiently searched references, scientific
  recovery, and resources; for `CompactCondition` and `TrialBanded` only.
- All admitted families including `Cascade34` as a kernel (PHRF-04) across
  the plan's validation matrix; the unrestricted-versus-parametric adequacy gap
  calibrated under null and misspecified families; the selection-dependent
  `sigma` plug-in's coverage measured before any calibration claim.
- Claimed intervals need `>= 500` replicates per regime with binomial
  coverage uncertainty.
